title: Industrial Gases Plant Manager
text:
**Position Summary**

The Industrial Gases Plant Manager is responsible for the safe, reliable, and cost-effective operation of an industrial gases production facility, ensuring uninterrupted production and supply of products such as oxygen, nitrogen, argon, hydrogen, and CO₂. The role provides leadership for operations, maintenance, safety, quality, and continuous improvement while meeting business, customer, and regulatory requirements.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead all plant operations to achieve safety, production, quality, and reliability targets.
* Ensure compliance with environmental, health, safety, and process safety management (PSM) standards.
* Drive operational excellence through continuous improvement, productivity, and energy-efficiency initiatives.
* Oversee maintenance and reliability programs to maximize plant uptime and asset performance.
* Manage plant budgets, operating costs, and capital improvement projects.
* Lead, coach, and develop plant personnel, fostering a culture of accountability and high performance.
* Ensure compliance with quality systems, customer specifications, and regulatory requirements.
* Coordinate with supply chain, logistics, engineering, and commercial teams to ensure uninterrupted product supply.
* Lead root cause investigations and implement corrective and preventive actions.
* Support plant expansions, upgrades, and commissioning activities.

**Management Responsibilities**

Directly manages plant leadership and operational personnel, including maintenance, operations, and technical staff. Carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with company policies and applicable laws. Responsibilities include interviewing, hiring, training, coaching, performance management, disciplinary action, succession planning, and employee development.

**Other Duties**

This job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or qualifications associated with the position. Duties and responsibilities may be modified at any time to meet the business needs of the organization.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* 8+ years of experience in industrial gases, chemicals, petrochemicals, refining, or other continuous process industries.
* 5+ years of leadership experience managing industrial gases plant operations.
* Strong knowledge of cryogenic processes, compressors, rotating equipment, utilities, and process control systems.
* Experience with DCS/PLC systems, reliability practices, and continuous improvement methodologies.
* Demonstrated leadership, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.

**Key Competencies**

* Safety Leadership
* Operational Excellence
* Team Development
* Financial & Business Acumen
* Reliability & Asset Management
* Strategic Thinking
* Communication & Stakeholder Management

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Safety performance and regulatory compliance
* Plant availability and reliability
* Production efficiency and energy consumption
* Product quality performance
* Budget and cost management
* Employee engagement and development
* Customer supply reliability

**Reports To**: President Plants and Operation Department

**Direct Reports**: Maintenance Manager and Plant Operations Team.

**Work Environment**

This position operates primarily within an industrial manufacturing environment and office setting. The Plant Manager regularly works in and around production equipment, compressors, cryogenic systems, utilities, and other industrial process operations. The role routinely uses standard office equipment, including computers, phones, scanners, and related technology. Frequent interaction with plant employees, contractors, customers, regulatory agencies, and corporate leadership is required. Occasional travel to company facilities, customer sites, industry meetings, and training programs may be required.

**Physical Demands**

This role requires a combination of office-based and plant-floor activities. The employee is frequently required to sit, stand, walk, climb stairs and ladders, communicate effectively, and use a computer for extended periods. The position may require working in varying environmental conditions, including exposure to industrial noise, temperature fluctuations, and process equipment. The ability to wear required personal protective equipment (PPE), including safety glasses, hard hats, hearing protection, steel-toed footwear, and other safety equipment as required, is essential. The employee may occasionally be required to lift and/or move up to 25 pounds.

**Position Type and Expected Hours of Work**

This is a full-time exempt position. The Plant Manager is expected to maintain a schedule sufficient to meet business and operational needs. Due to the nature of continuous industrial operations, the position may require availability outside normal business hours, including evenings, weekends, holidays, emergency response situations, planned maintenance outages, and on-call responsibilities as needed.

**Work Authorization**

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States and must maintain eligibility to work in the U.S. throughout their employment. Appropriate documentation authorizing employment in the United States is required upon hire.

**Equal Employment Opportunity Statement**

Air Water America is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to attracting, developing, and retaining a diverse workforce and fostering an inclusive work environment where all employees are treated with dignity and respect. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, protected veteran status, military status, or any other status protected under applicable federal, state, or local laws. Air Water America complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity laws and regulations and provides reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and religious observances as required by law.
